conviction_note: Event is real and company-confirmed (call 2026-09-15 08:30 ET); session precedent is amc-the-day-before (fiscal Q3 release issued 2026-05-11 for a 2026-05-12 08:30 ET call, 6-K filed 05-12), and the 09-09 call notice itself was issued 17:59 ET, so I accept the baseline's amc/09-14 label. Net -5.0 = a forced Nasdaq listing decision landing the same day as the print (-3.0) plus first audited accounts that must now measure an adjudicated $107.1m default (-3.5), partly offset by a two-notch credit upgrade at the operating subsidiary that never reached English-language media (+1.5); sized wide because the baseline has no usable option chain, no consensus EPS, and a reaction history the sweep correctly marked untrustworthy.

findings.finding: BIOX's Nasdaq 180-day minimum-bid-price compliance period expires TODAY, 2026-09-14 - the same session the FY26 results are due - and at $0.4350 compliance is arithmetically impossible, so within days the company must disclose either a transfer to the Nasdaq Capital Market with a written commitment to cure (in practice a reverse split) or a Staff delisting determination; it has no shareholder authority for a split, its 2026-01-30 AGM agenda carried only FY2025 accounts, four directors and the auditor, and no EGM has been noticed.
findings.why_not_priced: A known, dated, binary listing deadline should leave fingerprints and leaves none: run_up_20d is -4.05% and run_up_5d -0.74% (no drift into the date), short interest is 913,482 shares = 2.03% of float as of 2026-09-09, and the entire option chain is 2,023 contracts of open interest with a put/call OI ratio of 0.01 and no two-sided ATM market. Nobody has bought a put, shorted a share, or sold into it. If the market had focused on this you would see a bid for downside protection and a visible pre-deadline slide, as sub-$1 names routinely show in the fortnight before a compliance expiry. I checked the eligibility arithmetic myself rather than assuming the worst: total equity was $95.7m and MVPHS is roughly $18-24m, so BIOX does clear the Nasdaq Capital Market Equity Standard ($5m equity, $15m MVPHS) and a second 180 days is genuinely available - which is why the band runs positive at the top. The negative centre is that the cure it must commit to is a reverse split on a $27.6m equity, announced into the same release as a going-concern year.
findings.independence: Rule mechanics for a Global Select issuer (must transfer to the Capital Market and meet all Capital Market initial inclusion standards except bid price) confirmed independently at https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2025/01/23/2025-01621/self-regulatory-organizations-the-nasdaq-stock-market-llc-order-granting-approval-of-a-proposed-rule ; live price/date $0.4350 on 2026-09-14 from a different source at https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/biox/

findings.finding: The New York Supreme Court granted Jasper Lake partial summary judgment ON LIABILITY on 2026-06-16 - fourteen days before the 2026-06-30 fiscal year end - finding multiple Events of Default, valid acceleration, and liability of both the company and its guarantors, while striking Bioceres' proposed counterclaims as contractually waived; damages, default interest, contractual premiums, fees and the deficiency accounting on the $107.1m claim all remain open, so the FY26 audited accounts must now measure a liability that was a contingency at the last balance sheet date, against parent-attributable equity that has already fallen from $265.4m to $67.7m in nine months.
findings.why_not_priced: The disclosure exists but nothing has processed its accounting consequence. The stock moved +1.88% on the 2026-06-22 filing date, the calendar row carries no consensus EPS for this name at all, and there has been an eleven-week total news blackout between 2026-06-22 and the 2026-09-09 call notice - so no analyst has published a number for the provision and no one has to be surprised out of one. If the market had focused on it, a name whose total equity went $295.2m -> $106.6m -> $95.7m over three quarters while carrying an adjudicated default on $108.3m of already-current debt would not be sitting at a flat 20-day tape; you would see the equity-stub repricing that normally precedes a distressed FY print. The incremental item is not the principal (already on balance sheet as short-term debt) but the default-interest and make-whole layer plus the deficiency, now determined rather than disputed, and the loss of the counterclaim offset.
findings.independence: The equity path ($295.2m at 2025-06-30 -> $106.6m at 2025-12-31 -> $95.7m at 2026-03-31) and the explicit going-concern language come from two different documents I read separately: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1769484/000110465926027761/biox-20251231xex99d1.htm and https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1769484/000110465926059362/tm2614287d1_ex99-1.htm . Note the second half of this finding (the $3.4m contingent-consideration provision) sits in the SAME 6-K as the court ruling, so treat it as one document, not two.

findings.finding: FIX SCR (Fitch's Argentine affiliate) upgraded Rizobacter Argentina - the operating subsidiary that is essentially all of BIOX's continuing operations - two notches from CC(arg)/C(arg) to B(arg)/B(arg) with stable outlook in late June 2026, citing the 86%-adhesion exchange of $42.68m of Series IX/X notes out to 2029-09-03, positive free cash flow of US$58m in the twelve months to 2026-03-31, total debt down $65m to a $119m stock, and net debt/EBITDA falling to 9.2x from 19x at June 2025.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a CNV/Argentine local-credit-market event carried only in Spanish. StockTitan's BIOX news feed shows nothing at all between 2026-05-11 and 2026-09-09, so the English wire never carried it, and there is no sell-side coverage on a $27.6m equity to translate it. If it were priced, a subsidiary being upgraded two notches on $58m of cash generation would not coincide with the parent's shares making a 52-week low of $0.3013 over the following weeks. The transmission into tomorrow's print is that consolidated net financial debt - $212.9m at 2026-03-31 - should show a visible June-quarter fall, which is the one line in the release that cuts against the melting-ice-cube read at $0.43.
findings.independence: Same underlying FIX report as the ambito write-up, so those two count once. The genuinely independent corroboration is primary and from the SEC: the 2026-06-01 6-K confirming Rizobacter settled the exchange on 2026-05-29 with ~86% consent on ~$42.7m - https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1769484/000110465926068690/tm2616103d1_6k.htm

searched_and_found_nothing: Tested and DISCARDED the sharpest version of the listing thesis - that BIOX is ineligible for a second 180-day compliance period. Nasdaq Capital Market initial inclusion needs stockholders' equity >= $5m and MVPHS >= $15m; BIOX had $95.7m total equity at 2026-03-31 and, with only Jasper Lake (11.8%) clearly over the 10% exclusion threshold after AIGC fell to 6.89%, MVPHS is roughly $18-24m. The Equity Standard is met. Thesis dropped.

Argentine export-tax cuts (Decreto 423/2026: wheat and barley to 5.5% from 2026-06-05, soy stepping to 15% by Dec 2028) are a genuine FY27 tailwind for the campaign BIOX is selling into, but they are macro, decreed in June, and on every Argentine desk - not sized, to avoid padding.
The HB4 wheat / Colorado Wheat Research Foundation collaboration surfaced repeatedly as 'September 2026 news'. The URL paths say /2025/09/24/ - it is a year old. Dropped.

The Bioceres S.A. bankruptcy (Rosario commercial court, judge Fernando Mecoli, 2026-03-03) and the Noah Kolatch board resignation (2025-09-30) are both dated, widely reported and long in the price. Could not establish that the estate directly holds the Bioceres Group Limited / Bioceres LLC BIOX stakes, so no forced-seller finding.
No EGM notice, no reverse-split proxy, no F-3/ATM shelf and no equity issuance found in any filing after 2026-06-22.
No post-June-2026 docket entry in Jasper Lake Ventures One LLC v. Bioceres (Index 659704/2025) could be retrieved - law.com returned 403 and unicourt 405. No damages ruling appears to have issued.

No news, filing, insider Form 4 cluster or 13D/A of any kind between 2026-06-22 and the 2026-09-09 call notice. The blackout itself is the observation; I could not turn it into a sourced fact with a sign.
baseline_tension: There is nothing to agree or disagree with - the baseline's option chain is unusable (no ATM two-sided market, 2,023 total OI, no skew), its 6.41% expected move is a median of eight 6-Ks the sweep correctly says are not earnings, and short interest is 2.03% of float, so the market has expressed no view at all; my -5.0 is therefore not fighting a priced direction, it is filling a vacuum, and the flat 20-day run-up (-4.05%) into a listing deadline that expires on the print date is the single hardest fact to reconcile with anything being priced.
